note: Read-based census outcomes outside Contract A, each ruled by Nornic2. outOfContract: a function whose fresh context reaches no storage function that reads it while a request is in scope (the census's call graph over-approximates that reach). excludedPackages: tooling and test packages outside the product contract; the rule is a package no product package imports (no non-test file outside the package imports it), checked at each listed head. trackedDefects: a real defect filed for Linear (sig/handoff/linear-pending-issues.md), listed and counted until fixed. deferredPublicAPI: NOT an exclusion. Contract A is unfulfilled wherever a request holder reaches a substitution only across the public API (a caller in another package, or dynamic dispatch into an exported method, Engine or any other interface); each such site is listed and counted as unfulfilled-contract-a against this tracked deferral, never as a pass. Each entry is logged and counted; an entry that matches nothing fails. publicPackages: packages whose exported API, like storage's, is the deferred public boundary (Nornic2, 31 October 2026: exported auth APIs). publicEntries: single exported functions that are the same deferred boundary (Nornic2, 31 October 2026: cypher.RedactLiterals).
